facts.fact: The article states that the BCEAO instruction of 23 January 2024 defines payment institutions, distinct from banks, microfinance institutions and e-money institutions, among payment service providers, and that institutions are licensed under it across the UMOA, Cote d'Ivoire included.
The article states that, per the BCEAO list published 8 October 2026, Cote d'Ivoire had ten licensed payment institutions at 31 August 2026 (of 34 in the Union); the date is the list's as-of date.
